  agent/channels/eve.ts
    // Generated by donn; edit the persona, not this file.
    // The token is read per request, so `eve build` (which evaluates this module without the
    // run-time environment) never needs it.
    import { eveChannel } from "eve/channels/eve";
    import {
      extractBearerToken,
      localDev,
      withAuthChallenges,
      type AuthFn,
    } from "eve/channels/auth";
    
    const donnToken: AuthFn<Request> = withAuthChallenges(
      (request) => {
        const expected = process.env.DONN_ROUTE_TOKEN;
        const token = extractBearerToken(request.headers.get("authorization"));
        if (!expected || !token || token !== expected) return null;
        return {
          attributes: {},
          authenticator: "donn",
          principalId: "donn-local",
          principalType: "service",
        };
      },
      [{ scheme: "Bearer" }],
    );
    
    export default eveChannel({ auth: [donnToken, localDev()] });

  agent/lib/donn/env.ts
    // Generated by donn; edit the persona, not this file.
    // The environment variables donn's generated files read. Loading this module only warns;
    // the agent's model refuses to run while any is missing (see config.ts).
    const values: Record<string, string | undefined> = {
      AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY: process.env.AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY,
    };
    
    export function missingEnv(): string[] {
      return Object.keys(values).filter((name) => values[name] === undefined);
    }
    
    const missing = missingEnv();
    if (missing.length > 0) {
      console.warn(`donn: missing environment variables: ${missing.join(", ")}`);
    }
    
  agent/sandbox.ts
    import { defineSandbox } from "eve/sandbox";
    import { DockerSandbox } from "eve/sandbox/docker";
    
    export const environment = DockerSandbox.environment();
    export default defineSandbox(() => environment.open({ networkPolicy: "allow-all" }));
